text.p: These are the leading stories in the Angolan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The central committee of the ruling MPLA recommended on Thursday that the government pay striking teachers back wages owed from the first of the year. Angolan teachers have been on strike nationwide since mid-March.

- The state-owned diamond company, Endiama, held a seminar on Thursday on the exploration, extraction and commercialisation of diamonds. The seminar was attended by Angolans and foreigners involved in the diamond industry here.
- The commander of the national police, Fernando de Piedade dos Santos, continues a visit to Cabinda where he is visiting police and local commanders.
